slot.brief: A points to B saying 'he is the son of my grandfather's only son'; decode a short two-step chain to find the relation.

stem: Pointing to a boy, Leena said, “His father is the only son of my maternal grandfather.” How is the boy related to Leena?

verdicts.working: Leena’s maternal grandfather’s only son is her maternal uncle. His son is Leena’s cousin.

working:
